rules.statement: Every `decision` field gives exactly one of `text` with its `quote` (the `text` occurring in that quote) or an `absence`; only `posture` and `size` may be absent. `action_bias` is Overweight, Neutral, Underweight or Insufficient Information, `confidence` is Insufficient Information, Low, Medium or High, and `decision_date` is written Month D, YYYY. Every decision quote cites `prior_case`; `observations` is always present.
Every `thesis` field but `downside_sizes` gives exactly one of a `quote` from `prior_case` or an `absence`; `thesis`, `greatest_uncertainty` and `downside_paths` cannot be absent.

Cite only `prior_case`, `update` and `market_update`, each quote verbatim under its locator and its page read with `read_pages`; a source outside those three, or one that is unavailable or changed, is refused.

Before you give an `absence` or `outcome_absence`, search the pack for the item with `search_pack`; an absence claim with no recorded search is refused. Its `reason` and `follow_up` are analyst text (see decision_ledger.11), and an absence quote, if given, cites `prior_case`.

Each observation has `side` expected or realized and `metric` total_leverage, interest_cover, loan_bid or loan_offer, at most once per side and metric; loan_bid and loan_offer come together on each side, bid not above offer. An expected observation cites `prior_case`; a realized one cites `update` or `market_update`, never `prior_case`, from an issuer source for total_leverage and interest_cover and a third-party source for loan_bid and loan_offer. `value_text` is the figure as printed (digits, a point and two decimals), occurring once in the quote after its measure's label, and `as_of_text` is a Month D, YYYY date occurring in the quote as its only date; a realized as-of date is after the decision date.

Give realized observations or `outcome_absence`, never both and never neither. When a realized observation is given, `default_restructuring` is required: a quote from an issuer source other than `prior_case` that states default or restructuring, with `as_of_text` its only Month D, YYYY date, after the decision date. With `outcome_absence`, `default_restructuring` is null.

Each `thesis.downside_sizes` entry names `metric_id` total_leverage or interest_cover once and `comparator` above or below; its quote cites `prior_case`, is a span of the `thesis.downside_paths` quote, and states the measure, comparator and level as `<total leverage or interest cover> <comparator> <level>x`, with `level_text` the figure as printed (digits, a point, two decimals) occurring once in it.

`confidence` has one entry, once, for each compared metric, and none for another; a compared metric is total_leverage, interest_cover, or loan_mid, which needs bid and offer on both sides quoted on one date per side. Each `level` is High, Medium or Low.

Give one attribution for each compared metric and one for `overall`, each once; `label` is Thesis Confirmed, Flagged Risk Materialized, Unflagged Risk Materialized, Right for Wrong Reason, Premature / Mistimed or Insufficient Information. `process_sound` is Y, N or Not assessed: Not assessed exactly with Insufficient Information, Y with Flagged Risk Materialized, N with Unflagged Risk Materialized. With no compared metric, `overall` is Insufficient Information.

`flag_quote` is given only with Flagged Risk Materialized, as a span of your `thesis.downside_paths` quote, and the flagged metric needs a recorded `downside_sizes` entry that the realized value breaches strictly; a flagged `overall` needs one flagged metric so breached. `originating_module` is given only with Unflagged Risk Materialized and names a methodology module.

Each `basis`, `lesson`, `synthesis.text`, absence `reason` and `follow_up` is nonblank text with no digit, no braces or square brackets, not a null spelling, and none of blame, fault, should have, in hindsight, with hindsight, recommend, overweight, underweight, buy, sell, adjust the prior or calibrat.
Give at most two `lessons`, each with `metric_ids` naming only compared metrics.
